gaps.lead: People claim that this juice cures colds.
'I'm sorry I was rude to your sister,' Maria said.
gaps.sentence: Maria apologised ___ rude to my sister.
gaps.explanation: apologise for + -ing (or having + participle for the earlier action).

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.

gaps.lead: The tickets were so expensive that we didn't buy any.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ that we didn't buy any.
gaps.explanation: so expensive (tickets) → such expensive tickets (no article with plural).

gaps.lead: It was a mistake to sell the boat.
gaps.explanation: should/shouldn't have + past participle criticises a past action.

gaps.lead: This is the worst traffic I've ever experienced.
gaps.explanation: Never before + have + subject + participle: Never have I experienced.
